review.notes: Claims were checked against the linked primary or regulatory source. Evidence and causality are stated conservatively; independent human review is encouraged.

objective: Increase discovery of a large multilingual video catalog through organic search surfaces.
businessContext: A catalog exceeding 200,000 hours had limited web-video visibility despite substantial content supply.
strategy: Make video inventory machine-readable and keep discovery feeds current.
outcomes: Google's case study reports more than 3x traffic growth from Google and a 100% rise in video page views per organic-search session over six months.
whatWorked: Technical discoverability work matched a large existing content asset.
The implementation targeted both reach and depth of viewing.
whatFailed: The platform case study does not report a controlled counterfactual.
transferConditions: The site has substantial indexable video inventory and can maintain accurate structured data and sitemaps.
nonTransferConditions: Do not expect markup to compensate for thin, inaccessible or low-quality video pages.

sources.title: MX Player video optimization case study
sources.methodology: First-party platform case study reports implementation and before/after outcomes; no randomized control is described.

outcomeMeasurements.name: Video page views per organic-search session
